create_block_refinement_scheduler: create a BlockRefinementScheduler with custom block length, inference steps, and confidence threshold for iterative token refinement
run_scheduler_step: run a single refinement step on model logits to sample and commit confident tokens using the scheduler step method
set_scheduler_timesteps: set the timesteps and transfer schedule for the block refinement scheduler with a given number of inference steps
apply_top_p_filtering: apply nucleus top-p logit filtering to remove low probability tokens before sampling from model logits
add_noise_to_tokens: add noise to token sequences by randomly masking tokens with a mask token ID for semi-autoregressive training
